about.label: About Me
about.p1: Automation engineer at MST who designs test frameworks, validates API and streaming data flows, and handles the hard part of modern QA: testing non-deterministic LLM output via eval sets, LLM-as-judge, and answer-quality regression.
about.p2: Started in game development, moved through managing 100+ Google Ads accounts across 20+ countries, then built the automation tools myself — reducing an 8-person operations team to 1, backed by a 93-test suite. Treat AI as a force multiplier and pick the language for the task, not the habit.
about.p3: Today I work with Python, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Redis — building systems that emphasize testability, structured audit logging, data integrity, and real-time observability.
